summary: Payslip Module (Phases 1+2) comprehensive backend + frontend testing. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passed covering templates CRUD + validation, single/bulk assignment with reassignment history, calculation engine math (60% Basic=30000, HRA 40% chained on Basic, PF fixed non-proratable, extra_pay from payroll), generate/confirm/unconfirm/confirm-all workflow, regenerate-skips-confirmed, delete-confirmed 409, PDF download (%PDF magic + application/pdf), employee visibility rule (only confirmed + today>=5th-of-following-month, IST), and RBAC (employee 403 on all admin endpoints). Frontend: admin Payslips page renders, all 4 tabs (Templates/Assignments/Monthly/Preview) navigate, template create/edit/delete works via UI. Employee 'My Payslips' page loads, publish rule enforced (empty state shown correctly). All test data (templates, assignments, payslips, audit) cleaned up from Mongo at end.
critical_code_review_comments: payslip_module.py: no API endpoint to unassign / close an active payslip assignment without reassigning. Cleanup scripts must go direct-to-Mongo. Consider adding DELETE /payslips/assignments/{employee_id} for admin cleanup.

payslip_module.py compute_payslip: when a payroll_extra_pay component IS present, other_allowance is suppressed but the extra-pay component itself is still added to gross — good. When NOT present, other_allowance is added to net but NOT to gross_earnings; this may be intentional (side allowance) but is inconsistent with PDF which lists it under EARNINGS with no impact on Gross Earnings row. Consider clarifying.

server.py login latency: /api/auth/login intermittently takes >30s (observed 32s first-time; occasional 502 during hot reload). Consider async warm-up or connection pool tuning; not payslip-related but affects test flakiness.
payslip_module.py imports from server.py at module top (circular-ish). Fine currently but any refactor of server.py risks breakage.
